title: A six-step Padovan identity
summary: The Padovan numbers count tilings by dominoes and trominoes. A second recurrence uses only earlier terms of the same index parity.

tasks.title: Split the longer board
tasks.role: Expands the term of length n+7 by its possible first tiles.
tasks.context: Drop a first domino or a first tromino. These are disjoint and give the two shorter board lengths named in the claim.

tasks.title: Compare the middle and shorter boards
tasks.claim: ∀ n : ℕ, tilings (n + 4) + tilings (n + 3) = tilings (n + 5) + tilings (n + 1)
tasks.role: Replaces the leftover sum after splitting the longer board.
tasks.context: Expand all of P(n+4), P(n+3), and P(n+5) by their possible first tiles. The two sides reorganize the same four shorter counts, with P(n+3) itself expanded once more on the right.
